name: AI VFX Studio
intro: AI VFX Studio turns one still image into a short video with a preset effect, like a camera move, a transformation or an explosion.

features.ai-effects-tab: The AI Effects tab holds sixty four transformation presets. They're fun, attention-grabbing looks for short-form content, and you click a card to select one.
features.motion-controls-tab: Motion Controls has forty seven camera moves, like orbits, dolly zooms and crash zooms, giving a still shot a professional move without describing it.
features.vfx-tab: The VFX tab has nine dramatic effects, from explosions and tornadoes to levitation and decay. They work best when your image clearly shows the subject.
features.image-input-upload-or-url: Add your image by clicking the dashed box to upload, or paste a link to an image that's already online.
features.prompt-box: The optional prompt box is for naming your subject, like a red sports car, so the effect lands on the right thing. Keep it short.
features.aspect-duration-size-quality-dropdowns: Four dropdowns, Aspect, Duration, Size and Quality, let you match the clip to your platform and balance speed against quality.
features.results-grid: The results grid shows each video with playback controls and a Download link, with your newest result first.

outro: That's AI VFX Studio. Pick an effect that suits your subject, test with the defaults, and turn any still photo into a cinematic moment.
